family.name: OngLu / Luong
family.tagline: One Year of Family, Love & Memories
family.story: What a year it has been. From the very first moments together to every laugh, every meal shared, and every memory made — this family has grown into something truly beautiful. Today we pause to celebrate not just a milestone, but everything that brought us here.

timeline.title: Where It All Began
timeline.description: The OngLu and Luong families came together for the first time, laying the foundation for something that would grow beyond what any of us imagined.

timeline.title: Celebrations & Gatherings
timeline.description: Long afternoons, outdoor dinners, and the kind of laughter that carries into the evening. Summer brought the family closer, one gathering at a time.

timeline.title: Roots Growing Deeper
timeline.description: As the leaves changed, so did we — learning each other's rhythms, traditions, and stories. The family tree grew stronger with every shared moment.

timeline.title: Warmth Through the Cold
timeline.description: Holidays, warmth, and the quiet joy of belonging. Winter reminded us that no matter the season, family is always the warmest place to be.

messages.author: The OngLu Family
messages.message: To the Luong family — thank you for opening your hearts and your home. This year has been a gift we will carry with us always.

messages.author: The Luong Family
messages.message: Every family dinner, every story shared, every moment of joy — this year has given us a new definition of home. Here's to many more.

messages.author: Together
messages.message: May this be the first of many anniversaries we celebrate side by side. With gratitude, laughter, and love — always.
